jobs.title: LEGARZA BASEBALL PROGRAM COORDINATOR - Program Development
jobs.description:
Full-Time | Youth Sports, Coaching & Program Development

Help Build the Future of Baseball at Legarza Sports

Legarza Sports is seeing strong and growing demand for baseball across our camps, after-school classes, and leagues. We have talented coaches, excited families, and proven systems already in place. What we need now is the right leader to help bring it all together.
We’re hiring a Baseball Program Coordinator to work closely with Operations Director, our baseball expert and mentor, to develop, expand, and eventually help lead our baseball programming. This role starts hands-on and operational, with significant long-term growth potential for someone who brings leadership, organization, and passion for youth development.

About the Role

This is a hybrid role that combines:
Daytime PE instruction during the school year
Baseball program development and leadership across after-school classes, camps, leagues, and future club programming

You’ll begin by learning Legarza’s philosophies, systems, and teaching methods while coaching and supporting existing programs. Over time, you’ll take on increasing ownership of baseball curriculum, coach development, scheduling, and long-term program strategy.
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow into a leadership role rather than step into a finished one.

What You’ll Do

Program Leadership & Development
Help lead and expand Legarza’s baseball camps, classes, and leagues
Support the development of a club baseball program from the ground up
Improve and evolve baseball curriculum and training systems
Assist with coach development, training, and alignment
Collaborate closely with our Ops Director on vision, execution, and growth strategy

Coaching & Instruction
Coach after-school baseball classes, camps, and leagues
Teach PE programs during the school day
Deliver engaging, high-energy, developmentally appropriate instruction
Model strong communication, professionalism, and classroom management

Operations & Growth
Help coordinate scheduling, staffing, and program logistics
Support enrollment growth by delivering consistently excellent programs
Contribute ideas to expand offerings based on demand and community needs

Who We’re Looking For

You may be early in your leadership journey — but you’re serious about growth.
Required:
Baseball playing and/or coaching experience
Passion for youth development and teaching
Strong communication and organizational skills
Willingness to learn, take feedback, and grow into leadership
High energy, reliability, and professionalism

Preferred (not required):
Camp, club, and/or team coaching experience
Experience helping build or scale a sports program
Interest in long-term career growth in youth sports leadership

If you don’t meet every qualification but feel excited about this role, we still encourage you to apply.

Compensation & Growth

Starting pay: $25–$26/hour
Clear opportunities for advancement as the baseball program grows
Long-term leadership and ownership potential for strong performers
Compensation scales meaningfully with responsibility, impact, and program success
Medical, dental, and vision benefits (for eligible employees)
Paid holidays and vacation

This role begins at an entry-to-mid level while you learn our systems, but offers exceptional long-term upside for the right person who helps successfully build and lead the program over time.

Why Legarza?

Mission-driven organization focused on leadership, character, and excellence
Strong demand, proven infrastructure, and room to innovate
Supportive team culture with high standards
Real opportunity to grow alongside the company—not wait for a role to open

Learn more about our philosophy and values:
👉 https://www.legarzasports.org/Home/Philosophy

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – Role Description & Qualifications (Approx. 2500 characters)

Role Overview

The Data Analyst transforms raw information into meaningful insights that support decision-making across the organization. This role involves collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and interpreting data while producing clear reports, dashboards, and visualizations. It is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with numbers, identifying patterns, and using data to solve problems and improve performance.
Key Responsibilities

• Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to ensure accuracy.
• Analyze datasets to identify trends, correlations, and performance indicators.
• Create dashboards, charts, and visual reports to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
• Prepare summaries and presentations that highlight findings, risks, and opportunities.
• Collaborate with business, product, and technical teams to understand data needs and translate them into analysis tasks.
• Maintain databases, spreadsheets, and reporting tools to ensure high data quality.
• Support forecasting, performance tracking, and basic statistical analysis.
• Document methodologies, data sources, and assumptions to ensure reproducibility.
• Identify inefficiencies in data processes and contribute to workflow improvements.
• Monitor key metrics and alert relevant teams about unusual patterns or deviations.
Qualifications and Requirements

• Studies or experience in analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or related fields is beneficial.
• Strong analytical thinking and the ability to interpret complex datasets.
• Familiarity with tools such as Excel, SQL, Python, R, or data visualization platforms.
• Ability to create clear visualizations and summaries for audiences with varying technical backgrounds.
• Understanding of basic statistical concepts, data cleansing, and quality assurance.
• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Good communication skills to explain findings clearly and concisely.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work within deadlines.
• Problem-solving mindset and curiosity to explore data from different angles.
• Strong organizational skills and willingness to learn new tools and analytical methods.
Summary

The Data Analyst plays an essential role in enabling data-driven decisions and improving business performance through accurate analysis and reporting. This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy discovering insights, working with data, and contributing to strategic and operational improvements.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred
